name: Nitro Tag Misery
summary:
NTM  is a multiplayer VR horror experience that builds upon the innovative arm-based locomotion introduced by Gorilla Tag, developed by Another Axiom. In this game, players navigate through a series of haunting environments, each filled with dynamic challenges and unpredictable threats. Drawing inspiration from titles like Clouds Gorilla Horror, Fearing VR, and GDI Horror, NTM offers a fresh take on the genre, introducing unique maps, terrifying entities, and immersive gameplay mechanics.
